Street level (Can severely harm others with a single punchSecret Origins (1986) Special #1), Small Building level+ with weaponry (Can consistently harm Batman with his trick umbrellas.)
At least Supersonic+, possibly Hypersonic+ (Should be comparable to the likes of Batman and Nightwing)
Small Building level+ (Can take hits from Batman)
Below Average (He has been shown to wear out easily, and is an overweight man)
Standard Melee Range, Up to Hundreds of meters with weaponry

Varying trick umbrella, Handguns * Penguins Umbrella: Oswalds most notable weapon is his parasol, which he usually uses to walk, but it serves multiple functions in his battles against the Dark Knight. His umbrella sports blades which can rotate and spin around, acting as a propeller blade. This allows him to use it for flight and attack. Other features of the umbrella include a poisoned tip; built in flamethrower, taser and laser; knockout pellets; reinforced shield when opened; built in explosives and guns; etc.
Genius (He has outsmarted and even worked with The Joker, Batman, Riddler, and other of Gotham's smartest. He is a successful businessman as well as a mob boss)

Psychopathically obsessed with getting revenge on anyone who insults him. Note: Before making any changes to this page, please read and follow the Power-scaling Rules for Marvel and DC Comics. ==Notable Matchups== Victories: Mr.Burns (The Simpsons) Mr.Burns's profile (Both had everything they have, the battle took place on Mr.Burns nuclear power plant, Burns started in his office and The Penguin outside, both have one week of prepare time to search and create strategies, speed was equalized and Mr.Burns weapons and hounds where 8-A) Losses: Inconclusive: ==References== Category:Characters Category:Male Characters Category:Comic Book Characters Category:DC Comics Category:Villains Category:Parasol Users Category:Explosion Users Category:Fire Users Category:Poison Users Category:Martial Artists Category:Flight Users Category:Shield Users Category:Gun Users Category:Rich Characters Category:Criminals Category:Suicide Squad Members Category:Gangsters
9-B physically, 9-A with Weaponry

With his body and weaponized umbrellas, Penguin can use the following: *Superhuman Physical Characteristics (See Durability) *Judo Proficiency (Thought of by Alan Burnett, one of the DCAU's main producers, as having a notable amount of prowess in Judo) *Weapon Mastery (with his Weaponized Umbrellas - also seems to be a somewhat proficient fencer) *Preparation (Rigged the Gotham Zoo's aviary to make it a trap for Batman) *Flight (Can fly away with his helicopter umbrella) * Homing Attack (The missiles from his missile umbrella seek out their target, with him describing them as "Bat-seeking") *Acid Manipulation (Burnt a lock with acid from his umbrella) *Energy Projection (One of his umbrellas can fire white beams of energy) *Fire Manipulation (One of his umbrellas can become a blowtorch) *Gaseous Poison Manipulation (One of his umbrellas can fire a potent nerve gas) *Sleep Manipulation and Gas Manipulation (One of his umbrellas fires knockout gas) *Smoke Manipulation (Carried a smoke bomb) *Possible Electricity Manipulation (One of Batgirl’s dreams, during Batgirl Returns, shows him using an umbrella that shoots electricity) With Optional Equipment, he can use: * Poison Manipulation (Prepared hummingbirds with poison-tipped beaks)

Wall Level physically (At least 17 Kilojoules - Overtly far inferior to Batman in terms of physical strength. As someone with experience in combat and intimidation, should at least equal Doctor Destiny, who is treated as a completely normal man. Tore a license plate in two. Possibly helped kick a door off its hinges), Small Building Level with Weaponry and his Cassowary (Scaling to 0.095 Tons - Implied to be capable of harming Batman with his buzzsaw umbrella and blade umbrella - same with his gun umbrella. His energy projection umbrella did serious damage to the Batwing. His cassowary's talons could harm Batman. The missiles from his missile umbrella could blast away and seemingly harm his henchwomen, who could kick Batwoman through a stone wall. Though not certain, it's possible one of his umbrellas created this crater in a wall), can ignore durability with nerve gas and knockout gas

At least Average Human combat speed (Never demonstrated to be particularly fast, and his only battles with Batman are when he is weakened, either by being hit with nerve gas or blinded - Penguin not scaling to Batman in speed is highly consistent with things such as him being totally blitzed by Rocky Ballentine, who Batman casually danced around just a few scenes later), possibly far higher (Seemingly dodges a lunge from a blind Batman, though it's possible he simply missed), with Subsonic attack speed with his Missile Umbrella (Likely comparable to the muzzle velocity of Rocket Launchers, which generally is at least 300 m/s), and at least Supersonic attack speed with Gun/Machine Gun Umbrella (Likely at least comparable to the muzzle velocity of a common Glock, which is typically 375 m/s)

At least Wall Level, possibly higher (459.7 Kilojoules - Got up right after being kicked by Rocky Ballentine (who had a personal vendetta against him, and as such likely wasn't holding back) - Ballentine was overtly equal to his bodyguards, who could kick her through a wall. Was essentially unhurt by being right next to this explosion. Only winded by having a chandelier fall on him. Stayed conscious after a swing kick from Robin, though it's possible Robin was holding back - this is further evidenced by the fact that a nerve gas-weakened Batman (who Robin is physically comparable to, as explained here) knocked him out with a single kick)

Normal Human Weaknesses. Note: Bruce Timm has stated that the original DCAU tie-in comics are not canon, with the only tie in comics that have statements to the contrary (other than Batman: The Adventures Continue, which has so many continuity issues that it's essentially impossible to argue it's canon) being Justice League Infinity, the Batman and Harley Quinn tie in comics, and specifically the first annual of Batman Adventures. Ergo, I only consider those three comics canon. Category:Goulden1998 Category:Tier 9

* Superhuman Physical Characteristics (See Attack Potency, Speed, Lifting Strength, and Durability) * Superhuman Athleticism (Can leap inhumanly high) * Hand to Hand Combat Mastery (Studied Martial Arts in Asia, to the point that he's become a "master fighter" who can hold his own against Batman, the Joker, and the Kabuki Twins. Assembled a bomb for a heist. Built the Penguin Phoenix to kill Batman. Arranged for a volley of rocket umbrellas to level Wayne Manor) Various Umbrellas provide him with: * Fire Manipulation (One of his umbrellas can emit a jet of searing-hot flame) * Light Manipulation and Energy Projection (with his Laser Umbrella) * Explosion Manipulation (One of his umbrellas can release a miniature bomb, and his Rocket Launcher umbrella emits explosive rockets) * Electricity Manipulation and Paralysis Inducement (His sickle-and-chain umbrella can bind foes in its chain and electrify itself) * Sleep Manipulation (with his Knockout Gas Umbrella) * Directionally Limited Flight (with his Helicopter Umbrella and Rocket Umbrella) Other Optional Equipment provides him with: * His birds have Flight and Natural Weaponry with Talons. * Sleep Manipulation (with Knockout Gas Capsules) * Large Size and Fire Manipulation (Type 0: The Penguin Phoenix is a huge robot which can shoot a large spout of flame from its mouth) * Explosion Manipulation (with his Volley of Rocket-propulsed Umbrellas and a Bomb) * Paralysis Inducement (with Bola) * Energy Projection and Light Manipulation (with the Sun Channeler) * Animal Manipulation (Once used a sonic emitter to control bats) With the Green Lantern Ring, Penguin can utilize: * Flight (Utilizes true flight with the ring) * Telekinesis (Carried his umbrella using energy) * Energy Projection (Should be able to fire beams of Emerald Energy) * Construct Creation (Used the ring to create various energy constructs, such as a boot, an electric whisker, a hand, a vacuum, an umbrella, a boxing glove, a net, etc) * Forcefield Creation (Created a barrier to block attacks) * Vacuum Creation (Created a vacuum construct to suck up objects) * Paralysis Inducement (Confined Batman and Robin in a net construct)

The Phantom Stranger is one of the most knowledgeable characters in the DC universe, possessing extensive knowledge of magic, extradimensional realms, the afterlife, demons, etc. He can fashion powerful mystical artifacts and has been shown to know alien languages he has no obvious reason for knowing, and is often shown to already know the course of events before they happen. While not directly stated, the Phantom Stranger is often written as having some form of Nigh-Omniscience, though he has stated before that he is not truly omniscient.

Often prevented from interfering in situations beyond guiding others (presumably due to the Presence), and he displayed knowledge of the Spectre's conflict with the Anti-Monitor even after the multiverse was rewritten

The Phantom Stranger is one of the most knowledgeable characters in the DC universe, possessing extensive knowledge of magic, extradimensional realms, the afterlife, demons, etc. He can fashion powerful mystical artifacts and has been shown to know alien languages he has no obvious reason for knowing, and is often shown to already know the course of events before they happen. While not directly stated, the Phantom Stranger is often written as having some form of Nigh-Omniscience, though he has stated before that he is not truly omniscient.

Often prevented from interfering in situations beyond guiding others (presumably due to the Presence), and he displayed knowledge of the Spectre's conflict with the Anti-Monitor even after the multiverse was rewritten

The Phantom Stranger is one of the most knowledgeable characters in the DC universe, possessing extensive knowledge of magic, extradimensional realms, the afterlife, demons, etc. He can fashion powerful mystical artifacts and has been shown to know alien languages he has no obvious reason for knowing, and is often shown to already know the course of events before they happen. While not directly stated, the Phantom Stranger is often written as having some form of Nigh-Omniscience, though he has stated before that he is not truly omniscient.

Often prevented from interfering in situations beyond guiding others (presumably due to the Presence), and he displayed knowledge of the Spectre's conflict with the Anti-Monitor even after the multiverse was rewritten

Superhuman Physical Characteristics (See Attack Potency, Speed, Lifting Strength, and Durability), Elasticity (Plastic Man's unique physiology allows for the extension of every part of his body, as well as allowing him to flatten out and slip through practically infinitesimal cracks, such as a keyhole, the space under a door, a pipe, et cetera), Shapeshifting (Plastic Man can uncannily and seemingly limitlessly manipulate his body in order to drastically change his appearance - he can imitate other people, animals, and even inanimate objects if need be), Weapon Creation (Plastic Man can shapeshift parts of his body into facsimiles of weapons, giving him an advantage in battle), Regeneration (Low-High: Instantly reconstituted himself after being melted into a puddle. "Pulled himself together" after being melted into liquid by a chemical agent. Reformed his body after being literally sliced into ribbons. Was fine after being literally squashed flat), Mastery of His Own Fighting Style (Not only does Plastic Man presumably have some combat training considering his years of service with the FBI, but he also uses his unique physiology masterfully (thought of as "the master stretch artist of them all"), to attack in extremely unconventional ways, making him a very unpredictable and slippery opponent. He doesn't hesitate to attack the more vulnerable points of his opponents' bodies, such as poking their eyes out by extending his fingers), Size Manipulation (In various ways, Plastic Man has shown the ability to make parts of, if not all of, his body either far larger or far smaller), Attack Reflection (Projectiles, such as bullets, bounce off of him - this has, in the past, resulted in people being struck by their own bullets after firing them at Plastic Man. In two cases, even striking him with a handheld weapon caused the strike to rebound and hit the attacker), BFR (He can use his stretchiness to essentially become a human catapult, sending his foes great distances away when they charge him), Surface Scaling (Capable of using his feet as suction cups), Stealth Mastery (Disappeared on a man when his back was turned for an extremely short time, and snuck up on him to attack), Superhuman Athleticism (Can jump inhumanly high via bouncing), Gliding (Can either turn himself into a propeller to simulate flight, or assume the shapes of objects that can utilize limited flight), Paralysis Inducement (Can use his elasticity to wrap parts of himself around a foe, immobilizing them), Preparation (Prepared a sunlight reflector to vaporize Mr. Aqua, and acquired itching powder to incapacitate an opponent), Social Influencing (Convinced Woozy Winks to renounce his criminal ways), Natural Weaponry (Can stretch his teeth into snake-like fangs), Underground Mobility (Used his body as a drill, coming up from underground), Fourth Wall Awareness (Depicted as knowing he's in a comic book, turning and speaking to the audience), Resistance to Electricity Manipulation (Due to his body approximating the qualities of rubber, he is completely insulated against electricity - he can no-sell electricity of such a high voltage that it could instantly kill a normal man and blast through the wall of a bank) *Limited Wind Manipulation (By using himself as a propeller, he can create gusts so intense that they could completely cool down a lava man - said lava man was so hot he could melt steel like butter just by touching it. Can expel huge gusts of air, presumably by increasing the size of his lungs) *Limited Resistance to Fire and Extreme Heat (Rolled through flames without a singe, withstood a bear hug from a man made of lava, and was unhurt by being submerged in boiling taffy)

At least Large Building Level (Upscaling from 3 Tons of TNT - Could fend off and harm the Ogre, whose punches caused Plastic Man more overt pain than landing after a thirty-minute free fall did - Ogre was also said to be the strongest beast the world has ever known. Harmed and overwhelmed Madam Brawn, who could throw a chair with enough force to destroy a tank. Was seemingly able to harm a foe who was as large as a building and could cause a small earthquake by emerging from the ground. Frequently sends grown men into the air with his attacks. Oneshot a circus strongman who smashed through a wooden wall without the slightest injury and could get up after being slammed into a mountainside with enough force to embed his entire body several feet into the rock. Slammed a man into a large rock, splitting it in two. Kicked through a wooden wall. Hurt "Jets," who was unhurt by smashing through a ceiling. Threw a man through a wall. Twice harmed Gargantua, who threw a man through a wall. Pulled a man through a boarded-up wooden door. Bent a shotgun by kicking it. Slammed two men into concrete with enough force to create a huge crack in it. Much stronger than Woozy Winks, who can smash through a wall, smash through a wooden door, split a tree in half, and punch a man so hard he flew through a wooden door. Destroyed a stone statue with a single punch. Smashed through a window. Punched a man through a chain-link fence. Restrained a gorilla. Punched a man through the roof of his car. As depicted above, casually punches out hardened criminals - fodder athletic humans on Earth-Quality have demonstrated the strength to run through walls as well as the durability to remain conscious after an explosion that sent them above the clouds and emerge, only dazed, after tanking the explosion of an IED), possibly far higher (Twice harmed Gargantua, who had spent ten minutes being imbued with "hitherto unheard-of power")

Reacted to and flattened out to avoid a projectile at close

field_candidates.value: Likely physically. via plant control.

Superhuman Physical Characteristics, Plant Manipulation, Poison Manipulation, Empathic Manipulation (Can make love potions), Regeneration (Low), Fragrance Manipulation, Summoning (Mutation of plant-life making them able to act as her minions), Mind Control via Pheromones, Limited Telepathy (Telepathically linked to plant-life. Can communicate over long distances by using her plants), Resistance to Poison

Likely Small Building level+ physically (Stronger than Catwoman). Large Building level via Plant Control (Can create trees that can break apart buildings), her toxins can bypass durability to an extent
At least Supersonic+, possibly Hypersonic+ (Should be comparable to the likes of Batman and Nightwing)
Likely Small Building level+
Superhuman
Standard Melee Range; Tens of Kilometers with plants (Can reach plants from all around Gotham)
None notable
Gifted (Mainly in botany, knowledgeable in toxicology, human anatomy and chemistry)

Requires sufficient CO2 and sunlight to survive otherwise death (Though water can revive her). Feels the pain of her plants when harmed. Cannot control plant beings with consciousness, such as Harvest. Her plants are extremely susceptible to fire and bladed weapons Feats: Respect Thread Notable Attacks/Techniques: *Pheromones: Ivy's body produces pheromones that make people susceptible to mind control around her, although people with resistance to mind-control and strong will like Batman are usually capable of resisting. She was even once able to control Superman with the help of Kryptonite, though considering he has resisted mind control from insanely more powerful beings, this is most likely an outlier. *Toxins: Often these toxins are secreted from her lips and administered in her preferred way, a poisonous kiss, usually after professing false love or affection for her victim. They come in a number of varieties, from mind-controlling drugs, high-level hallucinogens and paralysis to instantly fatal toxins. These toxins are all around her body, to the point she can kill people just by touching them. They are even able to create hallucinations to her foes. *Resistances: Poison Ivy has a resistance to all matter of poison, hallucinogenics, bacterial disease and can overall not be affected by any sort of illness. Note: Before making any changes to this page, please read and follow the Power-scaling Rules for Marvel and DC Comics. ==Notable Matchups== Victories: Johnny Bravo (Johnny Bravo) Johnny's Profile (High 8-C Johnny was used) Losses: Inconclusive: Category:Characters Category:DC Comics Category:Female Characters Category:Poison Users Category:Plant Users Category:Comic Book Characters Category:Antagonists Category:Doctors Category:Criminals Category:Psychopaths Category:Regeneration Users Category:Mind Users Category:Telepaths Category:Martial Artists Category:Seduction Users Category:Humans Category:Adults Category:Villains Category:Evil Characters Category:Terrorists Category:Suicide Squad Members Category:Fragrance Users Category:Fungus Users Category:Misanthropes Category:Science Fantasy Characters Category:Anti-villains Category:Antiheroes Category:Summoners Category:Empathic Manipulation Users Category:Potion Users Category:Murderers Category:Prisoners Category:Scientists Category:Supervillains
9-A physically, far higher with Chlorokinesis and Plant Beasts

*Superhuman Physical Characteristics (See Attack Potency, Speed, Lifting Strength, and Durability) *Genius Intelligence (See Intelligence) *Superhuman Athleticism and Limited Acrobatics (Almost instantly scaled a small structure with no effort whatsoever) *Plant Manipulation (Despite the fact that, in her early appearances, she only exhibited the ability to control plants she made herself, by the time of Batman and Harley Quinn her chlorokinetic powers have become so advanced that she can control even plants she has not created herself - this can take the form of tendril-like plants she uses to restrain foes, vines she uses as platforms to raise herself upward, among other things. Made common houseplants secrete mind-manipulating chemicals) *Paralysis Inducement (Frequently uses plants to wrap around and restrain things) *Poison Manipulation (Despite needing Poisonous Lipstick during B:TAS, by the time of TNBA her kisses had become "Chernobyl-level toxic." Her crossbow bolts are poison-tipped) *Life Creation (Created sentient plant creatures, as seen here and here) *Preparation (Has rigged traps to take out Batman, as shown here and here. Rigged hundreds of pumpkins to secrete Poison Ivy gas when lit) *Life Manipulation (With just a snap of her fingers, turned a stick into a living plant monster) *Weapon Mastery (with her Crossbow) *Hand-to-Hand Combat Skills (Is skilled in various forms of combat, as evidenced in her fight with Harley Quinn) *Social Influencing (Charisma: Seduced an Arkham Asylum orderly in order to get into close proximity to a plant) *Resistance to Poison Manipulation, Radiation Manipulation, and Disease Manipulation (Her body instantly rejects any infection, poison, or outside contamination, something stated by Ivy herself not once, but twice. Totally unaffected by The Joker's laughing gas. Lived on a toxic waste dump (which she estimated would kill a normal person within ten minutes) without the slightest issue) With Optional Equipment, she can use: *Age Manipulation (A special pollen dust she has can age people back into toddlers) *Gas Manipulation and Poison Manipulation (Made a poisonous gas to bring down Batman) *Poison Manipulation and Natural Weaponry (Configured her plant beasts so that it poisoned people with its claws) *Wood Manipulation and Paralysis Inducement (Using an unspecified powder, encased Batman and Static in wood in moments) *Mind Manipulation (With her Reversal Powder (which turns good people evil and evil people good) and Mind-Manipulating Lipstick, which turns anyone she kisses into her slave) *Life Creation (Created sentient plant creatures, as seen here and here) *Transmutation and Paralysis Inducement (with Demetrite, which paralyzes people upon contact with their skin and turns them into trees)

Small Building Level physically (Downscaling from 0.095 Tons - Fought evenly with Harley Quinn, harming and staggering her several times. Sent The Joker flying with a kick, splitting a table. Though weaker, was able to begin to strangle Batman. Seemingly hurt Batman (disguised as Killer Croc) with a kick, though it's possible he was merely acting. Likely comparable to The Penguin's henchwomen, who kicked Batwoman through a thick stone wall), higher with Crossbow Bolts (Very strongly implied to be capable of piercing through Batman, who is stronger than she is), far higher with Chlorokinesis, Plant Beasts, etc. (Her plants have restrained the likes of Batman and Batgirl. Created tentacles of seaweed that destroyed a large boat. Her plant beast was implied to have knocked out Dick Grayson. Her chlorokinetic powers allowed her to struggle with and ultimately overpower an attack from The Floronic Man, who earlier was shown easily overpowering and beating down Batman and Nightwing. Destroyed a safe that wasn't even dented by several hits from Harley Quinn's mallet - said mallet swings being strong enough to down The Creeper. In one extremely high end, her plants could restrain Supergirl, and her plant beasts could even harm the Girl of Steel), Large Building Level or higher environmental destruction with Preparation (Her specially made "Demetrite," when spilled, caused this magnitude of plant growth), can ignore durability with her poisons

At least Subsonic travel speed with her plants (Can take her and Harley "miles away" in "moments"), Hypersonic (Scaling to Mach 8.7), possibly Relativistic+ (Scaling to 0.53c) reactions and combat speed, (Was able to evade several strikes from Batman. Dodged several attacks from and repeatedly tagged Harley Quinn, who is just as fast as Nightwing. Tagged The Joker with a kick, albeit catching him off guard), as well as Subsonic attack speed with her Crossbow (Crossbow bolts typically travel this fast, though perhaps slightly slower due to its small size) and Subsonic travel speed with her car (Scaling to the average speed of early-nineties cars)

Small Buildizng Level (Downscaling from 0.095 Tons - Should be capable of withstanding the force of her own blows. Took two hits from Nightwing, and several strikes from Harley Quinn - both of whom were presumably trying to knock her out. Was only annoyed by being struck so hard she flew through and shattered a wooden beam. Should be no less durable than Amanda Waller, who was unhurt by this explosion. Just as if not more durable than a 13-year-old Tim Drake, who shook off a hit from an incomplete Clayface, whose kicks could shatter a stone bench), and her plants have far higher durability (Can restrain the likes of Batman, not loosening no matter how much he struggles. In one instance, her plants were even capable of restraining a struggling Supergirl, though this isn't at all consistent)

Seemingly needs to sleep and eat. Extremely attached to her plant creations, to the point where killing them may cause her to become distraught and lose her composure. Her plant beasts have short lifespans, and seem to be weak to electricity. Note: Both Batman and Harley Quinn (evidence compiled here) and its tie in comic (stated here, is "in the world of BTAS") are canon to the DCAU, despite their tonal differences from many of the other properties within the DCAU. Note 2: Bruce Timm has stated that the original DCAU tie-in comics are not canon, with the only tie in comics that have statements to the contrary (other than Batman: The Adventures Continue, which has so many continuity issues that it's essentially impossible to argue it's canon) being Justice League Infinity, the Batman and Harley Quinn tie in comics, and specifically the first annual of Batman Adventures. Ergo, I only consider those three comics canon. Category:Goulden1998 Category:Tier 9

*Superhuman Physical Characteristics (See Attack Potency, Speed, Lifting Strength, and Durability) *Genius Intelligence (See Intelligence) *Hand-to-Hand Combat Mastery and Weapon Mastery with Blades (Is a "masterful warrior" who has "mastered many fighting disciplines") *Preparation (Frequently makes incredibly complicated and large-scale plans) *Social Influencing (Leadership: In every time period, is capable of manipulating dozens if not hundreds of people into following him. Is the most cunning of Batman's foes) If given preparation time, Ra's can utilize: *Summoning (Can summon Haahk) *Poison Manipulation (Uses a poisonous snake that incapacitates Batman) *Electricity Manipulation (His underling has an electricity gun) *Energy Projection (Wields an energy blaster) *Paralysis Inducement (His underlings use bola) *Power Absorption (The staff absorbed much of Superman's strength) *Explosion Manipulation (His underlings used a bomb) *Statistics Amplification (The climax of The Demon Reborn involved Ra's using the staff and machinery to absorb Superman's strength into himself) *Flight (His underlings are shown using hovercrafts)

Small Building Level (Scaling to 0.095 Tons - Harmed Batman with a kick, sending him flying, and dueled with him, the two of them clashing blades evenly several times. Broke the B:TAS-era Batrope, which could restrain the likes of Ubu - Ubu is this strong), higher with his sword - with Preparation, Ra's can cause Multi-Continental Environmental Destruction (His plan in The Demon's Quest, had Batman not put a stop to it, would have caused chemicals to cover most of the planet) and summon Haahk, who should have Large Planet Level Attack Potency at his peak (Downscaling from 1.03 Ronnatons - Even whilst considerably weakened, he took a blast from a bloodlusted Etrigan and is strongly implied to be a demon of similar power to him)

Hypersonic (Scaling to Mach 8.7), possibly Relativistic+ (Scaling to 0.53c) reactions and combat speed, (Kept up in a sword fight with Batman, and should be comparable to Talia who could tag Batman II)

Small Building Level (Scaling to 0.095 Tons - Should be capable of withstanding the force of his own blows. Took an elbow strike from Batman, as well as another strike during their battle. Got up and ran after being at ground zero of this explosion)

Suffers from age, and is prone to coughing fits. Otherwise, normal human weaknesses. Note: Bruce Timm has stated that the original DCAU tie-in comics are not canon, with the only tie in comics that have statements to the contrary (other than Batman: The Adventures Continue, which has so many continuity issues that it's essentially impossible to argue it's canon) being Justice League Infinity, the Batman and Harley Quinn tie in comics, and specifically the first annual of Batman Adventures. Ergo, I only consider those three comics canon. Category:Goulden1998 Category:Tier 9

Varies from Building level+ to Solar System level (Able to one-shot Damian, Can easily barrel through doors and punch through walls, stagger fully grown dinosaurs, force Wonder Woman and badly burned Superman's back with his Heat vision by accident, and damaged the Eradicator, who went toe-to-toe with Superman, albeit while the latter was admittedly weakened by the Rebirth continuity. Batman stated that Jon will be even more powerful than his father once he reaches his full potential, which he briefly accessed while being controlled by Manchester Black and could visibly harm his father with his blows. Jon's unrestrained energy output required the combined efforts of Superman, Kid Flash, Beast Boy, Raven, Starfire, and the Titans Tomorrow versions of Conner Kent, Cassandra Sandsmark, and Bart Allen to contain, but even then it needed to be sucked into hypertime by Savior to nullify it) | Solar System Level, potentially higher (Able to stagger General Zod. should be much stronger than before, as Batman stated that Jon will become more powerful than his father one he reaches his full potential)

Varies from Massively Hypersonic+ to Massively FTL+ (Outraced his father at one point, who raced Wally West but was still being caught off guard by Robin, Nobody, and Goliath. He later caught up to a speeding train and briefly managed to run and hide from Lex Luthor while the latter was using a set of armour imbued with New God technology. Defeated five supervillains that were battling the Teen Titans before Kid Flash, who is on par with Barry Allen, could react) | Massively FTL+ (Can operate and move in super speed mode alongside Superman and Jor-El and have a conversation with them, before laser blasts and missiles from multiple warships hit the ship they were on)

Varies from Building level+ to Solar System level (Knives and forks being tossed around by gale-force winds shatter against his skin. He also was thrown into a building without harm and traded blows with his father while under the control of Manchester Black) | Solar System Level (Withstood an onslot from General Zod)

Due to being half-Kryptonian, he does not have full control over his Solar Flare ability, which can potentially kill him if used twice in succession. Due to his Kryptonian heritage, he can be weakened and potentially killed by constant exposure to Kryptonite. He seems to still be subject to nausea when spinning rapidly, limiting his aerial maneuvers. Notable Attacks/Techniques: * Heat Vision: Like his father, Jon is able to emit concentrated solar energy through his eyes, allowing him to blast targets with searing energy beams. Those who are able to resist them are sent flying backwards instead. Jon's Heat Vision is powerful enough to badly singe his father's back and even a misfire was powerful enough to push back Wonder Woman as she blocked it with her bracelets. After Black Dawn, Jon has enough fine control over this ability to heat up firearms at a distance to the point that they're impossible for normal people to hold and incapacitate someone by burning minuscule holes through their legs. * Freeze Breath: Jon is also able to exhale large amounts of frigid air, flash freezing anything caught in range. However, it seems to be less potent than his father's, as Goliath was able to break free to catch both Jon and Maya soon afterwards. It was later shown to be potent enough to freeze a sludge monster created from genetic samples in the Batcave to the point that the monster shattered as plain ice when kicked by Damian Wayne. He has also demonstrated the ability to use simple Super-Breath, blowing his foes away with a powerful gust of wind. In Super Sons #8, he demonstrated the ability to reduce a magic clay statue back to normal by blowing all of the surface clay off of it. * Solar Flare: When pushed to the emotional brink, Jon can unleash his pent up solar energy in a massive burst that can annihilate his surroundings. This ability is powerful enough to deal severe structural damage to Titans Tower and render it uninhabitable even after Jon attempted to limit collateral by flying out of it while Raven erected a psychic forcefield around it. The second time this ability was triggered, Jon created a "super-storm" of energy that required the combined efforts of Superman, Kid Flash, Starfire, Beast Boy, Raven, and the Titans Tomorrow versions of Connor Kent, Cassandra Sandsmark, and Bart Allen to barely contain, eventually forcing Savior to redirect it into a hypertime wormhole to dissipate it. However, Jon's young age and Half-Kryptonian nature prevent him from fully controlling this ability, and single usage of this ability weakened his body enough such that a second burst would kill him.

Has harmed Firestorm and Etrigan with her strikes. Starfire can overpower Donna Troy and was able to knock back and stated to be able to beat her titaness form Troia, Donna Troy able to get the upper hand on Superwoman, evil universe counterpart to Wonder Woman and survive an explosion that hurt Superboy Prime. Starfire fought Post-Crisis Wonder Woman herself and hurt Silver Age Wonder Woman with a starbolt. Starfire also hurt Envy with Wonder Woman's powers. Harmed Sinestro with her starbolt and has harmed Green Lantern level entities on numerous occasions), Higher with nova (amplifies her power drastically briefly)

Immeasurable, likely Irrelevant (Fought Wonder Woman in melee and caught up to Wonder Woman's Invisible Jet which should be comparable to Wonder Woman. At least High Universe level (Survived a cosmic storm that was moving the universe off-balance and threatening the universe, can survive attacks from Titans 1 2 3 that were going to shake the cosmos in their battle the olympians), likely Universal+ (The cosmic storm was created an unprecedented warping in the spacetime continuum. Survived a blast from Orion, survived the attack of Silver Swan which could harm Wonder Woman, survived a blow from Envy with Wonder Woman's powers and from the demonic Shazam, Sabbac. Protected Jessica Cruz from radiation that was threatening her.)

Impulsive and overly emotional. Weakens without sunlight. Holds back and is sometimes naive and overly trusting (though this is somewhat inconsistent and depending on writing). *Superhuman Physical Characteristics (See Attack Potency, Speed, and Durability) *Hand-to-Hand Combat Mastery (Has months to years of training under Batman, and is playable in Rise of Sin Tzu - every single playable character in Rise of Sin Tzu is regarded by the game's manual as wielding "extraordinary martial arts abilities." Even Batman admired his "natural fighting skills." Has "natural athletic skills now honed by combat" and "plenty of combat experience," which Robin demonstrates by showcasing an acrobatic fighting style, with moves such as Flip Kick, Overhead Hammer (A spinning uppercut), Arm Sweep, a rush of flips and kicks, a leg-sweep, a breakdance-style kick, and momentum-based throws that use an enemy's own weight against them) *Acrobatics (Is a "superb acrobat", performing flips and acrobatic maneuvers to traverse his environment, avoid attacks from his enemies, recover from attacks, and facilitate his own attacks) *Superhuman Athleticism (Leapt inhumanly high to evade Talon's projectile screech. Made a large leap between a platform and a moving vehicle) *Stealth Mastery (Alongside Batman, snuck into Ferret's hospital room totally silently, to the point that Static had no idea the Dynamic Duo had entered the room. Easily snuck past Scarecrow goons and snuck up on Scarecrow without him noticing at all. Has seemingly taken very well to the stealth aspect of being a vigilante, describing it as "half the fun" of being Robin) *Paralysis Inducement (with the Batrope and Bola) *Electricity Manipulation (with Electrified Batarangs) *Smoke Manipulation (Every playable character in Rise of Sin Tzu wields smoke pellets as an on-hand gadget) *Weapon Mastery (with Batarangs, which he can throw precisely so that the return arc sliced cables above Two-Face, easily disarm gun-toting thugs, etc) *Bomb Defusal (Within Rise of Sin Tzu, Robin is one of the playable characters capable of defusing bombs) Later on, from Mystery of the Batwoman to Return of the Joker's flashback, Robin begins to display new abilities and gadgets, which makes sense considering the passage of several years: * Far Greater Hand-to-Hand Combat Mastery (Has kept up with his hand-to-hand combat training, and eventually trains himself to the point that his body is well-versed in "every trick the original Batman and Robin knew at their peak") With Optional Equipment, he has: *Sleep Manipulation (with the Tranq Darts he used in "Critters") *Acid Manipulation (with Herbicide) Due to being a close ally of Batman who has access to the Batcave, it stands to reason that his optional equipment could include all of Batman's equipment, as he could reasonably access it and use it in battle, which would give him a tremendous amount of additional abilities.

At most Small Building Level (Downscaling from 39.7 Megajoules - Though a bit younger, his comparable (if not more intense, on-the-job) training from Batman should allow him to be at least somewhat compare to a suitless Batman II, who is between 16 and 17. Despite being generally portrayed as the physically weakest member of the Bat-family, Robin is trusted to fend for himself by Batman, and his attacks can utterly obliterate a wooden barrel with a metal frame and knock a foe into a metal dumpster hard enough to total it. Slammed a man into a concrete street with enough force to crater it. Can fight and knock out goons in Rise of Sin Tzu - random fodder enemies in that game can get up after having a giant wooden crate slammed on their head hard enough to completely obliterate it (with Robin also being capable of shattering these wooden crates with a simple parry) - which would come out to about 530 KJ. In addition, during one story mission, common enemies in Rise of Sin Tzu are shown to, over time and with several minutes of constant attack, wear down and damage the Batcave's thick metal security doors. Can consistently knock criminals out in single attacks), possibly higher (With difficulty, karate-chopped through the Bat-cuffs, which have successfully restrained many Bat-rogues over the years - however, he did this by striking a single link in the chain. Harmed this goon, who earlier was not knocked out by a swing kick from Batman. Shown to have leg-swept and temporarily beaten down a Freeze goon who got up after a kick from Batgirl. Threw film reels hard enough to harm Two-Face. However, Robin scaling to those characters has its own share of antifeats. For example, during "Knight Time," Robin cannot even budge Bruce Wayne, and is casually restrained by the latter with one arm, even when Wayne was literally not cognizant of his actions. Furthermore, during "Growing Pains," Robin is completely incapable of budging an incomplete Clayface with his attacks) | Small Building Level (Scaling to 0.095 Tons - Several years older and more experienced than his 13-year-old counterpart. At the time of Return of the Jokers flashback, since Robin was still active as a hero, he should be at least as strong as himself when he is several-decades-retired, a state in which his body was still a strong enough vessel for The Joker to inhabit, making Batman II go limp with a punch combo (generally trouncing him throughout their fight, as confirmed by the notes in ROTJ's screenplay) and being called a "deadlier" version of the Clown Prince of Crime, tossing Batman through a wooden table. The Joker instructed Harley Quinn to fake a mugging to take Robin off guard in order to capture him, implying at least some lack of confidence in Harley defeating the Teen Wonder head-on)

Hypersonic (Scaling to Mach 8.7), possibly Relativistic+ (Scaling to 0.53c) reactions and combat speed (Stated to be faster than Nightwing and Batman. Hit Poison Ivy with a weapon swing even after announcing his presence. Dodged several slashes from Shiv and threw a bola fast enough to tag Talon, both of whom are consistent nemeses of Static. Reacted to and steered around fired missiles from the Jokermobile), with Superhuman running speed (Kept ahead of a charging mutant bull) | Hypersonic (Scaling to Mach 8.7), possibly Relativistic+ (Scaling to 0.53c) reactions and combat speed (Should be at least as fast as his less experienced early-teenage self. Also should be at least as fast as himself when he's been retired for many years, wherein his body was quick enough to keep up with and repeatedly land blows on Batman II), with Superhuman running speed (Kept up with Batman whilst both of them were running to escape an explosion)

Small Building Level (Downscaling from 39.7 Megajoules - Should compare to his Attack Potency as per Newton's Third Law. Can withstand having large wooden barrels fragmented against him. Easily shook off a strike from an incomplete Clayface - said incomplete Clayface's kicks could shatter a stone bench. Walked off being struck by a Gorilla, said Gorilla's strength likely being amplified), possibly higher (He and Batgirl were both struck by a Mr. Freeze goon holding a block of ice, yet he got up first) | Small Building Level (Scaling to 0.095 Tons - Should be capable of withstanding his own physical power)

Furthermore, Tim apparently has a firm grasp of assorted scientific techniques including biology, engineering, and genetics, which he has been shown to use in his attempts at re-cloning Superboy. Batman states that Tim could potentially become more intelligent and capable than himself, as proven when he single-handedly foiled Ras' al Ghul's plans, with the latter begrudgingly referring to him as Detective, an accolade previously reserved for Batman. Like the rest of the Bat-Family, Tim is an expert in hand-to-hand combat and can take on all but the best fighters in close combat. He is primarily depicted to wield a staff in combat, analyzing and exploiting his foes' weaknesses to trip them up before going for the takedown)

He also regularly spars with Nightwing and Batman. He has also used staves, swords, spears, knives, and other armaments, even managing to hold off Deathstroke long enough to send money to the latter's account. Also, having been raised by the League of Assassins, he is adept in stealth maneuvers, detective work, vehicle operation, and other skills. He is also empathetic towards animals, owning several pets, including a cowardly but physically strong and flight-capable gargoyle named Goliath. However, having been spoiled and raised with limited social interaction, he is often arrogant to the point of being reckless, with his lack of a father figure in his earlier years making him desperate to seek acknowledgment and recognition from him. Thus, he sometimes makes poor decisions when he gains the upper hand)

Standard human weaknesses. Reluctant to kill due to his father's teachings. Can be impulsive, reckless, and overconfident at times. Poor social skills make him a poor team player outside of his own family. Feats:

Can kill the Coney Island Zombies), Genius Intelligence (Extraordinary Genius), Chaos Manipulation, Order Manipulation (As the Angel of Retribution was stated to have the power of both the Lord of Chaos and the Lord of Order Harley Quinn Vol 3 #66), Reality Warping, Plot Manipulation (Wields the power of continuity stating that specific symbols will appear at the end of every comic and receiving notifications during crossover events, she is also the narrator for a large portion of her stories addressing the reader as "dreamers, hustlers, and schemers" Harley Quinn Vol 3 #66 Harley Quinn Vol 3 #71; Harley was capable of accidentally destroying all of DC Continuity to a greater degree than that of the Milk Wars Harley Quinn Vol 3 #50 ), possesses the red-black lantern ring, briefly the green lantern ring, and possesses the yellow lantern ring, Pain Manipulation, Memory Manipulation, Dimensional Travel, Portal Creation (As Hammer Harleen, her hammer contains a mother box which can torture one-thousand people at once, force her to focus on a single memory, as well as create boom-tubes allowing her to teleport from place to place), Indomitable Will (Was unphased after having 94-thousand different calculations on how to break her personality), Resistance to Madness Manipulation (Could look into Johnny Sorrows face which is stated to be the true face of madness), Plot Manipulation (Was unaffected by the final wave which wiped DC's Continuity),

As Monarch, he was easily able to deduce the plan of a Monitor, who wanted to be the sole winner of this expansive war.Countdown to Final Crisis Vol 1 16 In addition, he entered a long war with the Monitors and created an army of superhumans to follow his every command. An adept leader of both the JLI, Extreme Justice, and a large team of heroes during the Invasion storyline,Invasion! Vol 1 2 as well as a multiversal army of supervillains.

If the laws of nature are tampered with, his powers weaken. His eyes aren't as durable as the rest of his body. If his skin is breached, he can cause a powerful explosion of quantum force. Two quantum field manipulators can cancel out each other's powers. Often, he tries to hold back his power levels due to potential God Complex and fears he is losing his humanity.Captain Atom: Armageddon Vol 1 6 X-Ionized weapons can cut his skin. If Captain Atom absorbs too much energy at once, he will be sent hurtling through time. Depending on the type of energy absorbed, he either goes forward or backwards. Sometimes after he goes nuclear, it takes up to 24 hours for his powers to return. Captain Atom also fears turning into his dark side known as Monarch.Extreme Justice Vol 1 8 As Monarch, he was very ruthless and overconfident. His Monarch armor is not as sturdy as his Captain Atom shell. If his Armor gets breached, it can accidentally release enough energy to destroy an entire Universal space-time continuum. Notable Attacks/Techniques, Hold back: Captain Atom almost always holds back for various reasons. It can be his mental state, his emotional state, or some other inner conflict he is going through. In addition, he fears his dark side taking over and getting the better of him. Therefore, his power varies greatly and rarely ever go all out. In Captain Atom Vol.2 54 - 57 he stopped holding back momentarily, which led to him creating and destroying a universe over and over again with but a mere thought. As Monarch, he had no such mental weakness and always fought at his full strength., Talk first: Captain Atom is a man with a lot of trauma, he would rather talk than go all out and fight someone. He is a kind man and is willing to hear them out first rather than hurt them - when possible, of course. And even if he attacks, he rarely ever attack first. As Monarch, he likes to emotionally hurt his opponents and hold the higher ground intellectually before unleashing his power against them., Energy over matter: Captain Atom's primary method of attack is energy manipulation. He has more control over its output compared to his other destructive abilities. Even when battling in melee combat, he prefers to employ energy in any way he can., BFR: As Monarch, sometimes he would simply remove his enemies from the battlefield rather than waste time on them., Quantum Field: By manipulating the Quantum Field, Captain Atom is able to control time, and matter at will. His energy absorption is potent enough to overcome foes significantly more powerful than himself, Big Bang: Captain Atom is also able to control incredible amounts of energy, being able to catalyze another Big Bang if he so wished, This file only covers his Post-Crisis incarnation and not the New 52 or the original from Charlton Comics., Captain Atom can perform at various levels of powers since he has complete control over his destructive capabilities. In addition, his emotional and mental state also plays a large role in it. To avoid his potential God Complex or evil self from taking control, he tries to hold back as much as possible and all of his stats tend to go down with him., If possible, please avoid scaling characters from Captain Atom, sans Superboy-Prime. When scaling characters from Captain Atom, please read over the context to understand how Captain Atom was acting and feeling beforehand, as well as afterwards., Some writers tend to ignore the character, as well as his power levels, so if he fights someone, it does not mean they scale to his Galaxy level or higher level, especially since most of them boils down to how out of character Nathaniel is written., And if you do want to scale characters from him, please only scale those who battles him in a prolonged story arcs. One or two page battles are often to be ignored due to how his character is written sometimes., Monarch Armor slightly augments his powers according to a back-up story, the main story arc contradicted the said enhancements. Therefore, the main story takes precedence over a back-up issue, which was written to feel like a handbook., In addition, the power levels of Captain Atom aren't that different than his usual self. In this form, he doesn't hold back at all since he is a villain and utilises everything he has in his arsenal.Countdown to Final Crisis Vol 1 8 He has many statements and scaling in his usual form which doesn't contradict any potential higher showings with the Monarch armor., Captain Atom was not empowered when the sliver of Void took residence within him during Captain Atom: Armageddon story arc. If the laws of nature are tampered with, his powers weaken. His eyes aren't as durable as the rest of his body. If his skin is breached, he can cause a powerful explosion of quantum force. Two quantum field manipulators can cancel out each other's powers. Often, he tries to hold back his power levels due to potential God Complex and fears he is losing his humanity.Captain Atom: Armageddon Vol 1 6 X-Ionized weapons can cut his skin. If Captain Atom absorbs too much energy at once, he will be sent hurtling through time. Depending on the type of energy absorbed, he either goes forward or backwards. Sometimes after he goes nuclear, it takes up to 24 hours for his powers to return. Captain Atom also fears turning into his dark side known as Monarch.Extreme Justice Vol 1 8 As Monarch, he was very ruthless and overconfident. His Monarch armor is not as sturdy as his Captain Atom shell. If his Armor gets breached, it can accidentally release enough energy to destroy an entire Universal space-time continuum. Notable Attacks/Techniques, Hold back: Captain Atom almost always holds back for various reasons. It can be his mental state, his emotional state, or some other inner conflict he is going through. In addition, he fears his dark side taking over and getting the better of him. Therefore, his power varies greatly and rarely ever go all out. In Captain Atom Vol.2 54 - 57 he stopped holding back momentarily, which led to him creating and destroying a universe over and over again with but a mere thought. As Monarch, he had no such mental weakness and always fought at his full strength., Talk first: Captain Atom is a man with a lot of trauma, he would rather talk than go all out and fight someone. He is a kind man and is willing to hear them out first rather than hurt them - when possible, of course. And even if he attacks, he rarely ever attack first. As Monarch, he likes to emotionally hurt his opponents and hold the higher ground intellectually before unleashing his power against them., Energy over matter: Captain Atom's primary method of attack is energy manipulation. He has more control over its output compared to his other destructive abilities. Even when battling in melee combat, he prefers to employ energy in any way he can., BFR: As Monarch, sometimes he would simply remove his enemies from the battlefield rather than waste time on them., Quantum Field: By manipulating the Quantum Field, Captain Atom is able to control time, and matter at will. His energy absorption is potent enough to overcome foes significantly more powerful than himself, Big Bang: Captain Atom is also able to control incredible amounts of energy, being able to catalyze another Big Bang if he so wished, This file only covers his Post-Crisis incarnation and not the New 52 or the original from Charlton Comics., Captain Atom can perform at various levels of powers since he has complete control over his destructive capabilities. In addition, his emotional and mental state also plays a large role in it. To avoid his potential God Complex or evil self from taking control, he tries to hold back as much as possible and all of his stats tend to go down with him., If possible, please avoid scaling characters from Captain Atom, sans Superboy-Prime. When scaling characters from Captain Atom, please read over the context to understand how Captain Atom was acting and feeling beforehand, as well as afterwards., Some writers tend to ignore the character, as well as his power levels, so if he fights someone, it does not mean they scale to his Galaxy level or higher level, especially since most of them boils down to how out of character Nathaniel is written., And if you do want to scale characters from him, please only scale those who battles him in a prolonged story arcs. One or two page battles are often to be ignored due to how his character is written sometimes., Monarch Armor slightly augments his powers according to a back-up story, the main story arc contradicted the said enhancements. Therefore, the main story takes precedence over a back-up issue, which was written to feel like a handbook., In addition, the power levels of Captain Atom aren't that different than his usual self. In this form, he doesn't hold back at all since he is a villain and utilises everything he has in his arsenal.Countdown to Final Crisis Vol 1 8 He has many statements and scaling in his usual form which doesn't contradict any potential higher showings with the Monarch armor., Captain Atom was not empowered when the sliver of Void took residence within him during Captain Atom: Armageddon story arc. The sliver of Void was merely creating a chain reaction inside of him to bring out his destructive power.

These are powers or abilities that are commonly displayed amongst members of the Green Lantern Corps in order for them to combat their enemies effectively, though do keep in mind not every member shares the same hax these are just the ones that are inherent byproducts of being a member of the Green Lantern Corps...Willpower Manipulation, Emotional Manipulation, Energy Manipulation via Emotional Energy Manipulation (Members of the Green Lantern Corps harness the power of willpower from the Emotional Energy Spectrum in order to fuel their ringsGreen Lantern: Rebirth #3 (February, 2005), it's also stated hereGreen Lantern Vol 5 #21 (August, 2013)), Indomitable Will, Flight, Creation (By using their imaginations members of the Green Lantern Corps can create constructs using their rings, Two-Six states this to be an akin to an equation with an infinite amount of possible outcomes), Telepathy (Members of The Green Lantern Corps can communicate with other members via telepathic sub-channels),

(Team Wide) Universal+ Destructive Capacity via Green Lantern Ring (Any Lantern whom uses a power ring is continuously draining the finite emotional spectrum of their universe which upon emptying ultimately results in the complete destruction of the universe itself, this is stated on multiple occasions) ==Standard Member Paraphernalia== Depending on the skill and willpower of the wearer, it can do almost anything. The first Green Lantern Ring on Earth in modern times was crafted and worn by Alan Scott and powered by the mystical Starheart. His proved to be the exception, the by-product of the efforts of the Guardians of the Universe to contain the magic of the universe. The Guardians also created the more widespread version, powered by individual Green Lantern Power Batteries through a connection to the Central Power Battery on Oa. With the exception of the ring worn by Alan Scott, the current rings are based on the one given to Kyle Rayner when he was the only Green Lantern in existence. All power rings need periodic recharging. The process is not instantaneous so many Green Lanterns recite an oath while the ring charges. The oath is not required to charge the ring, but is recited to reaffirm the person's commitment to the Green Lantern Corps, and to measure the time it takes the ring to charge. While many Green Lanterns create their own oath, the majority use the Corps' official oath as a sign of respect. In the interests of political correctness on the part of DC (or, in context, Hal Jordan), the word "blackest" was replaced by "darkest"; this practice has been abandoned with the reinstating of the Green Lantern Corps due in part to the significance of the Blackest Night comic event. Particularily alien Green Lanterns may have modified oaths. For example, Rot Lop Fan, a Green Lantern from a starless sector, replaces light with sound in his oath. The Central Power Battery is the reservoir of power for the emotional spectrum of willpower, and channels the energy used to empower the Green Lantern Corps. All of the green energy housed within a Green Lantern ring comes from a smaller battery, which in turn, functions as a conduit to the Central Power Battery on Oa. It was built billions of years ago, when the highly evolved Maltusians (now known as the Guardians of the Universe) united their powerful minds to create a green crystal - green because it was a mixture of their blue mental energy and a yellow impurity "necessary to fix its form." They grew the crystal and carved it into the shape of a giant battery, and from the same crystal carved smaller batteries and power rings. The Central Power Battery has been destroyed and rebuilt several times. It was first destroyed several years ago by the forces of Krona. Unfortunately, the battery exploded during an assemblage of all 3,600 members of the Green Lantern Corps, several of whom were killed instantly. The surviving members struggled valiantly to put out the rampaging inferno of green energy that swept across the Oan Citadel. The next cataclysmic event occurred after Sinestro's execution, which resulted in the renegade being imprisoned inside the battery. The energy of the Green Lanterns' power source started to drain their rings, stripping most of them of their power. In the end, it took the combined efforts of Hal Jordan and Appa Ali Apsa to stop the battery from exploding and creating a black hole. However, the damage caused to the battery rendered the Green Lantern Corps almost useless, with only a few Green Lanterns with active power rings scattered throughout the universe.

*Cannot harm anything that is yellow. *Rings only hold a limited energy and must be recharged with a power source on a regular basis. *If the user is filled with dread, they will be unable to use the ring and become vulnerable to the hue yellow. *If Green Lantern loses focus or concentration (for example, due to illusions), his strength weakens. (Basically don't edit my page without my consent) ==Explanations & Related Blog Posts== *Emotional Energy Spectrum: Green occupies the central position in the spectrum and symbolizes the emotion of willpower. It holds the distinction of exerting the least influence on its wielder and can only be mastered by individuals with an indomitable will capable of overcoming great fear. The embodiment of this emotion is Ion. The Maltusians initially harnessed this energy, which later passed on to the Oans, male Maltusians who aspired to establish order in the universe. After the Controllers departed, those remaining on Oa evolved into the Guardians of the Universe. These are powers or abilities that are commonly displayed amongst members of the Green Lantern Corps in order for them to combat their enemies effectively, though do keep in mind not every member shares the same hax these are just the ones that are inherent byproducts of being a member of the Green Lantern Corps...Willpower Manipulation, Emotional Manipulation, Energy Manipulation via Emotional Energy Manipulation (Members of the Green Lantern Corps harness the power of willpower from the Emotional Energy Spectrum in order to fuel their ringsGreen Lantern: Rebirth #3 (February, 2005), it's also stated hereGreen Lantern Vol 5 #21 (August, 2013)), Indomitable Will, Flight, Creation (By using their imaginations members of the Green Lantern Corps can create constructs using their rings, Two-Six states this to be an akin to an equation with an infinite amount of possible outcomes), Telepathy (Members of The Green Lantern Corps can communicate with other members via telepathic sub-channels),

(Team Wide) Universal+ Destructive Capacity via Green Lantern Ring (Any Lantern whom uses a power ring is continuously draining the finite emotional spectrum of their universe which upon emptying ultimately results in the complete destruction of the universe itself, this is stated on multiple occasions) ==Standard Member Paraphernalia== Depending on the skill and willpower of the wearer, it can do almost anything. The first Green Lantern Ring on Earth in modern times was crafted and worn by Alan Scott and powered by the mystical Starheart. His proved to be the exception, the by-product of the efforts of the Guardians of the Universe to contain the magic of the universe. The Guardians also created the more widespread version, powered by individual Green Lantern Power Batteries through a connection to the Central Power Battery on Oa. With the exception of the ring worn by Alan Scott, the current rings are based on the one given to Kyle Rayner when he was the only Green Lantern in existence. All power rings need periodic recharging. The process is not instantaneous so many Green Lanterns recite an oath while the ring charges. The oath is not required to charge the ring, but is recited to reaffirm the person's commitment to the Green Lantern Corps, and to measure the time it takes the ring to charge. While many Green Lanterns create their own oath, the majority use the Corps' official oath as a sign of respect. In the interests of political correctness on the part of DC (or, in context, Hal Jordan), the word "blackest" was replaced by "darkest"; this practice has been abandoned with the reinstating of the Green Lantern Corps due in part to the significance of the Blackest Night comic event. Particularily alien Green Lanterns may have modified oaths. For example, Rot Lop Fan, a Green Lantern from a starless sector, replaces light with sound in his oath. The Central Power Battery is the reservoir of power for the emotional spectrum of willpower, and channels the energy used to empower the Green Lantern Corps. All of the green energy housed within a Green Lantern ring comes from a smaller battery, which in turn, functions as a conduit to the Central Power Battery on Oa. It was built billions of years ago, when the highly evolved Maltusians (now known as the Guardians of the Universe) united their powerful minds to create a green crystal - green because it was a mixture of their blue mental energy and a yellow impurity "necessary to fix its form." They grew the crystal and carved it into the shape of a giant battery, and from the same crystal carved smaller batteries and power rings. The Central Power Battery has been destroyed and rebuilt several times. It was first destroyed several years ago by the forces of Krona. Unfortunately, the battery exploded during an assemblage of all 3,600 members of the Green Lantern Corps, several of whom were killed instantly. The surviving members struggled valiantly to put out the rampaging inferno of green energy that swept across the Oan Citadel. The next cataclysmic event occurred after Sinestro's execution, which resulted in the renegade being imprisoned inside the battery. The energy of the Green Lanterns' power source started to drain their rings, stripping most of them of their power. In the end, it took the combined efforts of Hal Jordan and Appa Ali Apsa to stop the battery from exploding and creating a black hole. However, the damage caused to the battery rendered the Green Lantern Corps almost useless, with only a few Green Lanterns with active power rings scattered throughout the universe.

*Cannot harm anything that is yellow. *Rings only hold a limited energy and must be recharged with a power source on a regular basis. *If the user is filled with dread, they will be unable to use the ring and become vulnerable to the hue yellow. *If Green Lantern loses focus or concentration (for example, due to illusions), his strength weakens.
